Redfin Oct 29 2026 release (PR Newswire copy, opened in full) was checked for Atlanta rows: it gives only Atlanta new listings -26.5 percent and pending sales -25.9 percent, with no Atlanta sale-to-list, so no Redfin figure is on this card; its national rows (98.3 percent, 21.5 percent price drops) were left out because the card is about Georgia. headline:
Selling In South Metro
Henry Got 96.6% Of List
turn_1: Echo, in September Henry County sellers got 96.6% of their original list price, up from 95.0% a year ago.
turn_2: But I keep hearing about price cuts.
turn_3: That number is measured from the original price, so the cuts are already counted. Homes sold in 54 days, down from 79 a year ago.
echo_line: Midnight headline scrolling is officially over for me. The cuts were in that number the whole time.
source: Simply List Atlanta, Henry County report · September 2026 · read Oct 30, 2026
disclaimer: Henry County figures for September, not a valuation of any home. Results differ by county, price range and condition.
